name: Loop wraith
description: a pale translucent ghost of the Cracked Road in a tattered hooded shroud, hollow glowing cyan eyes, the lower body unravelling into thin looping threads of light

poses.stand: floating, shroud rippling, threads of light looping beneath it, facing right
poses.struck: struck: threads snagging and knotting in a bright flash, eyes wide
poses.dead: unravelled completely into a spiral of fading threads

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
